title: A manifest carrying an ARTIFACT_ROOT_VIOLATION blocks the proof gate (CONSULT half only)
retires: F-CLASS-21 artifact half, CONSULT ONLY (round-4 G5: no live observed-writes producer exists; AC-R6.3 is NOT enforced end-to-end in production); R6/AC-R6.3 partial
notes: CONSULT HALF ONLY (round-4 G5). The driver hand-builds the manifest with observed=[stray] because NO live producer of observed writes exists: node_verdict's write_manifest call passes no observed=, operator result.json carries no artifact list, and there is no workspace write-scan — so in production violations is always [] and AC-R6.3 does not fire. What this scenario DOES prove, red-green: a manifest carrying ARTIFACT_ROOT_VIOLATION blocks _evaluate_proof_obligations even though the declared obligation is satisfied (GREEN), and with SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=0 the contamination is invisible and the gate passes (RED). The catalog row is 'partial' with the missing producer named in pending_remainder; the path-selection half of class 21 is Lane 0.5's preflight (verified).
